crossRefs.note: He said, “At this season, when the time comes around, you will embrace a son.” She said, “No, my lord, you man of God…
The woman conceived, and bore a son at that season, when the time came around, as Elisha had said to her.
After these days Elizabeth his wife conceived, and she hid herself five months, saying,
“Thus has the Lord done to me in the days in which he looked at me, to take away my reproach among men.”
Behold, Elizabeth your relative also has conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her who was…
He gave him the covenant of circumcision. So Abraham became the father of Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day.…
For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the servant, and one by the free woman.
By faith, even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted…
God said, “No, but Sarah, your wife, will bear you a son. You shall call his name Isaac. I will establish my covenant…
But I will establish my covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this set time next year.”
He said, “I will certainly return to you at about this time next year; and behold, Sarah your wife will have a son.”…
Is anything too hard for Yahweh? At the set time I will return to you, when the season comes round, and Sarah will have…
For this is a word of promise, “At the appointed time I will come, and Sarah will have a son.”

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Sarah
people.line: Wife of Abraham; mother of Isaac

translations.web: Sarah conceived, and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.
translations.bsb: So Sarah conceived and bore a son to Abraham in his old age, at the very time God had promised.
translations.kjv: For Sarah conceived, and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken
translations.asv: And Sarah conceived, and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.
